title: FinSTaR: Towards Financial Reasoning with Time Series Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.03460v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series (TS) reasoning models (TSRMs) have shown promising capabilities in general domains, yet they consistently fail on financial domain, which exhibit unique characteristics. We propose a general 2 x 2 capability taxonomy for TSRMs by crossing 1) single-entity vs. multi-entity analysis with 2) assessment of the current state vs. prediction of future behavior. We instantiate this taxonomy in the financial domain---where the distinction between deterministic assessment and stochastic prediction is particularly critical---as ten financial reasoning tasks, forming the FinTSRBench benchmark based on S&P stocks. To this end, we propose FinSTaR (Financial Time Series Thinking and Reasoning), trained on FinTSR-Bench with distinct chain-of-thought (CoT) strategies tailored to each category. For assessment, which is deterministic, we employ Compute-in-CoT, a programmatic CoT that enables models to derive answers directly from raw prices

translated_title: FinSTaR：面向金融推理的时间序列推理模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列推理模型在通用领域展现了良好的能力，但在具有独特特征的金融领域中却持续表现不佳。我们提出了一种通用的2×2能力分类法，通过交叉1）单实体与多实体分析，以及2）当前状态评估与未来行为预测，来对时间序列推理模型进行分类。我们在金融领域中实例化了这一分类法——其中确定性评估与随机性预测之间的区别尤为关键——将其划分为十个金融推理任务，基于标准普尔股票构建了FinTSRBench基准。为此，我们提出了FinSTaR（金融时间序列思考与推理），在FinTSR-Bench上针对每个类别采用不同的链式思维策略进行训练。对于确定性评估，我们采用了Compute-in-CoT，一种程序化的链式思维方法，使模型能够直接从原始价格推导出答案。
tldr: 本文提出FinSTaR模型和FinTSRBench基准，通过2×2能力分类法将金融时间序列推理分为评估与预测任务，并采用定制化链式思维策略（如Compute-in-CoT）来提升金融领域的推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FinSTaR and FinTSRBench, using a 2×2 capability taxonomy to categorize financial time series reasoning into assessment and prediction tasks, with tailored chain-of-thought strategies (e.g., Compute-in-CoT) to enhance reasoning in the financial domain.
